description.p: Mass-download LRC synced lyrics for your offline music library.
LRCGET will scan all files in your chosen directory for music files, download lyrics as LRC files with matching names, and save them alongside your music files.
This independently maintained fork adds waveform and timed-lyric editing improvements by Rick Lidgett. The original LRCGET project and authors retain their credits and license.

description.p: Optional Enhanced LRC export alongside TXT and standard LRC, with saved word timestamps and a configurable default.
Pending waveform markers change only the original sentence Sync button color.
Clear Confirm controls for pending markers, visible Cancel, and reliable F1 help.
Overlap prevention is a saved Configuration setting. The Synced toolbar shows a read-only On/Off status beside Timing step, preventing accidental changes near Loop.

Live marker previews use the existing sentence Sync buttons. Optional overlap protection is on by default. Standard LRC export preserves confirmed gaps of at least 250 milliseconds and final end cues; exact ends remain in saved editor data.

Loop stays enabled while navigating between lyrics. Selected markers retarget repetition; untimed selections and inactive tabs suspend it without losing the toggle. Explicit Off restores continuous playback.

Hover help is off by default with a saved Configuration toggle. F1 requests help on demand; enabled hover help expires after two seconds. Settings saves preserve the previous choice on cancellation or failure.
Hover help dismisses after two seconds, even with a stationary pointer. Clicking, scrolling, Escape and leaving dismiss it immediately. Descriptions remain accessible and help never captures input.

ul.li: Added live neighboring-lyric boundary warnings while preserving intentional overlaps.
Fixed looping a final lyric with an inferred recording-end boundary.
Includes labeled marker/playback clocks, range highlighting, click playback and zoom continuity.
Updated illustrated features and editing guides for this independent fork.

Improved word-by-word syncing, multilingual word splitting, and word segment editing.
Added a configurable keyboard shortcuts menu and shortcut hints.
Added playback speed controls from 0.5x to 2x in the main player and lyrics editor.
Added multiple-line selection, bulk timestamp adjustments, and clearer line timing indicators.
Added search to Albums and Artists, full-text library search, and clickable album and artist names.
Fixed writing embedded lyrics to MP3 files, including malformed ID3v2 comment language fields.
Fixed the Download button continuing to spin after completion and an error in LRCLIB challenge verification.
Redesigned the app UI with a cleaner, more neutral color scheme for better contrast and visual hierarchy in both light and dark modes.
Sped up Albums and Artists list tabs by adding proper indexes in the database.
Fixed individual lyrics export error in the lyrics editor.
Lyrics editor no longer blocks saving when both plain and synced lyrics are empty.
Added ability to import synced lyrics from an .lrc file (via file picker) or directly from clipboard into the lyrics editor.

Removed dead code and refactored the mass lyrics exporter to use a background queue (similar to the downloader). You can now close the export modal and reopen it later via the header button to check progress.
Reduced memory overhead during mass download and export operations by limiting log buffers and removing unnecessary reactive arrays that are causing memory leaks.
Add support for Lyricsfile — an open, extensible lyrics format in YAML syntax
